# Overview

The following datasets will be used to create a Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet which will have tabs according to the BLM assumptions considered (HA 10% Closed System, HA 10% Open System, and HA 80% Closed System)

1.  **Clean WaDE Synoptic Survey dataset** (WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean.xlsx)

Variables selected: sample ID, site, date, inherent characteristics, developed land cover, BLM predictors.

2.  **WaDE Synoptic Survey dataset** (WaDE_Synoptic_Summary.xlsx, "SITE INFO" tab)

Variables selected: network, regime, elevation, upstream distance from main stem, drainage area, developed land cover by site

3.  **BLM Speciation Mode** (Zn_Speciation.det.xlsx)

Variables selected: free ion, biotic ligand (BL) bound elements, inorganic complexes, and organic complexes.

4.  **BLM Toxicity Mode** (Zn Toxicity on C. dubia.det.xlsx)

Variable selected: total Zn concentration to cause certain type of toxicity to the given organism

# HA 10% Closed System

## 1. Clean WaDE Synoptic Survey

```{r}
library(readxl)

WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt_sep/WaDE Dataset Cleaning/WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean.xlsx")

head(WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean)
```

Inspect the structure

```{r}
str(WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean)
```

Select sample ID, site, date, flow regime, flow state, developed land cover, BLM predictors

```{r}
library(dplyr)

bio_ms <- WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample_ID,
    Site,
    Date,
    Regime,
    Flow_state,
    pH,
    Temp_C,
    DOC_uM,
    Ca_uM,
    Mg_uM,
    Na_uM,
    K_uM,
    SO4_uM,
    Cl_uM,
    DIC_uM,
    Zn_uM,
    Cu_uM
         )

# check
head(bio_ms)
```

## 2. WaDE Synoptic Survey

Import the original (pre-cleaning) WaDE Synoptic Survey dataset "SITE_INFO" tab for inherent characteristics and developed land use by site.

```{r}
library(readxl)

WaDE_Site_Info <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt_sep/WaDE Dataset Cleaning/WaDE_Synoptic_Summary.xlsx", 
    sheet = "SITE INFO")

head(WaDE_Site_Info)
```

Inspect the structure

```{r}
str(WaDE_Site_Info)
```

From WaDE_Site_Info we'll select network, regime, elevation, upstream distance from main stem, drainage area, developed land cover by site and apply it to all samples by site

```{r}
library(dplyr)

bio_ms <- bio_ms %>%
  left_join(
    WaDE_Site_Info %>%
      rename(
        Relative_elevation_m = `elevation (m) (USGS 3DEP)`,
        Dist_from_EFPC_km    = `Upstream of EFK_KM`,
        Drainage_area_km2    = `DrainageArea_SqKm`,
        Developed_lulc       = `lulc_developed_%`
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Site,
        Network,
        Relative_elevation_m,
        Dist_from_EFPC_km,
        Drainage_area_km2,
        Developed_lulc
      ),
    by = "Site"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Relative_elevation_m = as.numeric(Relative_elevation_m),
    Dist_from_EFPC_km    = as.numeric(Dist_from_EFPC_km),
    Drainage_area_km2    = as.numeric(Drainage_area_km2),
    Developed_lulc       = as.numeric(Developed_lulc)
  ) %>%
   relocate(
    Network,
    Relative_elevation_m,
    Dist_from_EFPC_km,
    Drainage_area_km2,
    Developed_lulc,
    .after = Flow_state
  )

# check
head(bio_ms)
```

Inspect the structure again

```{r}
str(bio_ms)
```

## 3. BLM Speciation Mode

If you haven't already, convert the Zn_Speciation.det.xlsx to the newest Excel Workbook version before importing them.

Import dataset

```{r}
library(readxl)

Zn_Speciation_ha10_cs <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt_sep/Zinc/1. Running BLM/Data outputs/Speciation Mode/Zn_speciation_ha10_cs.det.xlsx")

head(Zn_Speciation_ha10_cs)
```

Clean dataset

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

Zn_Speciation_ha10_cs_clean <- Zn_Speciation_ha10_cs %>%
  # 1) Drop rows 1–3
  slice(-(1:3)) %>%
  
  # 2) Set first remaining row as column names
  { 
    nm <- as.character(.[1, ])
    nm <- make.unique(nm)
    out <- .[-1, ]
    names(out) <- nm
    out
  } %>%
  
  # 3) Remove units row (now the first row)
  slice(-1) %>%
  
  # 4) Rename ID columns
  rename(
    Sample_ID = `Site Label`,
    Site      = `Sample Label`
  ) %>%
  
  # 5) Clean Sample_ID and convert others to numeric
  mutate(
    Sample_ID = str_extract(Sample_ID, "WaDE_\\d+"),
    across(-c(Sample_ID, Site), ~ as.numeric(str_replace_all(.x, '"', "")))
  )


# Preview
head(Zn_Speciation_ha10_cs_clean)

# Sanity check: make sure Sample_ID matches to that of the Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet called bio_ms (should be 386)

Zn_Speciation_ha10_cs_clean %>%
  inner_join(
    Zn_Speciation_ha10_cs_clean %>% 
      dplyr::select(Sample_ID),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  summarise(n_matched = n())
```

Select variables, add a suffix indicating their units, and add to bio_ms

```{r}

        TOrg_H_M         = `TOrg.H`,
        TOrg_Ca_M        = `TOrg.Ca`,
        TOrg_Mg_M        = `TOrg.Mg`,
        TOrg_Na_M        = `TOrg.Na`,
        TOrg_K_M         = `TOrg.K`
      ) %>%
      select(
        Sample_ID,
        Free_Zn_M,

        Zn_OH_2_M,
        ZnCO3_M,
        ZnHCO3_M,
        ZnSO4_M,
        ZnCl_M,

  "ZnSO4_M",

  "ZnS_M",
  "TOrg_Zn_M",

  "BL_ZnOH_mol_kg",

  "H2S_M",
```

Import the Zn Toxicity on C. dubia.det.xlsx

```{r}
library(readxl)

Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha10_cs <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt_sep/Zinc/1. Running BLM/Data outputs/Toxicity Mode/Zn_toxicity_ha10_cs.det.xlsx")

head(Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha10_cs)
```

Data cleaning

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha10_cs_clean <- Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha10_cs %>%
  # 1) Drop rows 1–3
  slice(-(1:3)) %>%
  
  # 2) Set first remaining row as column names (and make them unique)
  {
    nm <- as.character(.[1, ])
    nm <- make.unique(nm)
    out <- .[-1, ]
    names(out) <- nm
    out
  } %>%
  
  # 3) Remove units row (now the first row)
  slice(-1) %>%
  
  # 4) Rename ID columns
  rename(
    Sample_ID = `Site Label`,
    Site      = `Sample Label`
  ) %>%
  
  # 5) Clean Sample_ID + strip quotes + convert everything else to numeric
  mutate(
    Sample_ID = str_extract(Sample_ID, "WaDE_\\d+"),
    across(-c(Sample_ID, Site), ~ as.numeric(str_replace_all(.x, '"', "")))
  )

# Preview
head(Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha10_cs_clean)

# Sanity check: match count vs Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet (bio_ms)
bio_ms %>%
  inner_join(
    Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha10_cs_clean %>% dplyr::select(Sample_ID),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  summarise(n_matched = dplyr::n())
```

Select the T.Zn variable (total amount of Zn to cause the toxicity to the organism) and add to bio_ms

```{r}
library(dplyr)

bio_ms_ha10_cs <- bio_ms_ha10_cs %>%
  left_join(
    Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha10_cs_clean %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        Zn_Toxicity_Daphnia_M = T.Zn
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Sample_ID,
        Zn_Toxicity_Daphnia_M
      ),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  )


# Make sure they're numeric
zn_new_vars <- c("Zn_Toxicity_Daphnia_M")

# Convert them to numeric
bio_ms_ha10_cs <- bio_ms_ha10_cs %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(zn_new_vars), ~ as.numeric(.)))

# Check
str(bio_ms_ha10_cs)
```

## 5. Export to Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet

Since we're saving the data from BLM run as a **closed system assuming HA at 10%**, we'll save it to the Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet into a tab called HA 10% Closed System:

```{r}
library(openxlsx)

file_path <- "Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet.xlsx"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create workbook if file does NOT exist
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
  
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "HA 10% Closed System")
  writeData(wb, "HA 10% Closed System", bio_ms_ha10_cs)
  saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)

} else {

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. If the file EXISTS, load it and add/overwrite the sheet
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  wb <- loadWorkbook(file_path)

  # Add sheet if missing
  if (!"HA 10% Closed System" %in% names(wb)) {
    addWorksheet(wb, "HA 10% Closed System")
  }

  # Write/overwrite data in that sheet
  writeData(wb, "HA 10% Closed System", bio_ms_ha10_cs)

  # Save
  saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
}
```

## 5. Export to Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet

Since we're saving the data from BLM run as a **open system assuming HA at 10%**, we'll save it to the Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet into a tab called HA 10% Closed System:

```{r}
library(openxlsx)

file_path <- "Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet.xlsx"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create workbook if file does NOT exist
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
  
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "HA 10% Open System")
  writeData(wb, "HA 10% Open System", bio_ms_ha10_os)
  saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)

} else {

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. If the file EXISTS, load it and add/overwrite the sheet
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  wb <- loadWorkbook(file_path)

  # Add sheet if missing
  if (!"HA 10% Open System" %in% names(wb)) {
    addWorksheet(wb, "HA 10% Open System")
  }

  # Write/overwrite data in that sheet
  writeData(wb, "HA 10% Open System", bio_ms_ha10_os)

  # Save
  saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
      dplyr::select(Sample_ID),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  summarise(n_matched = n())
```

## 4. BLM Toxicity Mode

Import the Zn Toxicity on C. dubia.det.xlsx

```{r}
library(readxl)

Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha80_cs <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt_sep/Zinc/1. Running BLM/Data outputs/Toxicity Mode/Zn_toxicity_ha80_cs.det.xlsx")

head(Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha80_cs)
```

Data cleaning

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha80_cs_clean <- Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha80_cs %>%
  # 1) Drop rows 1–3
  slice(-(1:3)) %>%
  
  # 2) Set first remaining row as column names (and make them unique)
  {
    nm <- as.character(.[1, ])
    nm <- make.unique(nm)
    out <- .[-1, ]
    names(out) <- nm
    out
  } %>%
  
  # 3) Remove units row (now the first row)
  slice(-1) %>%
  
  # 4) Rename ID columns
  rename(
    Sample_ID = `Site Label`,
    Site      = `Sample Label`
  ) %>%
  
  # 5) Clean Sample_ID + strip quotes + convert everything else to numeric
  mutate(
    Sample_ID = str_extract(Sample_ID, "WaDE_\\d+"),
    across(-c(Sample_ID, Site), ~ as.numeric(str_replace_all(.x, '"', "")))
  )

# Preview
head(Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha80_cs_clean)

# Sanity check: match count vs Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet (bio_ms)
bio_ms %>%
  inner_join(
    Zn_Toxicity_on_C_dubia_ha80_cs_clean %>% dplyr::select(Sample_ID),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  summarise(n_matched = dplyr::n())
```

Select the T.Zn variable (total amount of Zn to cause the toxicity to the organism) and add to bio_ms

```{r}

  left_join(

      ) %>%

  mutate(across(all_of(zn_new_vars), ~ as.numeric(.)))

# Check
str(bio_ms_ha80_cs)
```

## 5. Export to Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet

Since we're saving the data from BLM run as a **open system assuming HA at 10%**, we'll save it to the Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet into a tab called HA 10% Closed System:

```{r}
library(openxlsx)

file_path <- "Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet.xlsx"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create workbook if file does NOT exist
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
  
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "HA 80% Closed System")
  writeData(wb, "HA 80% Closed System", bio_ms_ha80_cs)
  saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)

} else {

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. If the file EXISTS, load it and add/overwrite the sheet
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  wb <- loadWorkbook(file_path)

  # Add sheet if missing
  if (!"HA 80% Closed System" %in% names(wb)) {
    addWorksheet(wb, "HA 80% Closed System")
  }

  # Write/overwrite data in that sheet
  writeData(wb, "HA 80% Closed System", bio_ms_ha80_cs)

  # Save
  saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
}
```
